claims: "Popular" is a 2023 song by The Weeknd, Madonna, and Playboi Carti.
"Popular" is featured on The Idol Vol. 1 (Music from the HBO Original Series).
"Popular" spent over 30 weeks on the UK charts.
"Popular" was released as part of the soundtrack for the HBO series The Idol.
The chorus of "Popular" frequently repeats "Beggin' me to come over/Just to get a taste of being popular".
The chorus/hook of "Popular" is "She / To be popular / She-she / To be popular / She / To be popular / She-she / To be popular".
Forbes reported it as a career-defining moment for its reach.
There is another song called "Popular" from the musical Wicked.
"Popular" from the musical Wicked was sung by Kristin Chenoweth (2003).
"Popular" from the musical Wicked was covered by Ariana Grande (2024).
"Popular" from the musical Wicked is about a girl giving another a makeover.
